headline: Dexcom Opens €300 Million Medical Device Facility in Athenry, Ireland
summary: US medical technology firm Dexcom has opened a €300 million manufacturing plant in Athenry, Ireland, producing continuous glucose monitoring devices for diabetes management and creating an estimated 1,000 jobs.
why: Large foreign direct investments in European medical manufacturing expand medtech production capacity and local employment.

impacts.name: DexCom Inc
impacts.why: The firm inaugurated a €300M device production facility in Ireland.
